title: Role-play lab: six withdrawal conversations
objectives: Answer six withdrawal conversations using gaps, buckets and guardrails.
Use the module's scenario answers (Q21–Q25) as trainer-marked practice.
body_md:
In pairs. One person plays the client, the other explains — in plain words, with a rupee example. Scenarios: New retiree — Mr. Iyer, 60, has ₹1 Cr, spends ₹6 L a year and has a ₹2 L pension. High withdrawal — Mrs. Rao wants ₹80,000 a month from ₹1 Cr. Panic in year one — a new retiree's equity bucket fell 18%; he wants to move all to FDs. Big family request — a retired client wants to give ₹15 L to her son. All in FDs — a couple keeps ₹80 L in FDs and spends ₹4 L a year. SWP from equity — a client runs his SWP directly from a small-cap fund.

> **Investor takeaway:** Quiz scenarios Q21–Q25 (trainer-marked): a scenario answer earns its mark if it covers at least three model points and makes no promise of returns.
example: Role-play Mr. Iyer: gap ₹4 L (4% rate), three buckets, SWP from a liquid fund, health-cover check, illustrations with assumptions, no promises.
say: Gap, buckets, SWP source, health cover — no promises.
Show the rate and its effect before deciding.
never: Promise the corpus will last a set number of years.
Present an SWP as guaranteed income.

check.q: Mr. Iyer, 60, has ₹1 Cr, spends ₹6 L a year and gets a ₹2 L pension. What is the plan?
o: SWP of ₹6 L a year from equity
Gap = ₹4 L (4% rate); set up three buckets; SWP from a liquid fund; check health cover; show illustrations with assumptions; no promises
check.why: Gap = ₹4 L (4% rate); set up three buckets; SWP from a liquid fund; check health cover; show illustrations with assumptions; no promises.

check.q: Mrs. Rao wants ₹80,000 a month from ₹1 Cr. What do you show her?
o: Show the ≈9.6% rate and how quickly it may run out (illustrative); discuss lower spending, other income or delaying extras
check.why: Show the ≈9.6% rate and how quickly it may run out (illustrative); discuss lower spending, other income or delaying extras.

check.q: A new retiree's equity bucket fell 18% and he wants to move all to FDs. What do you do?
o: Move everything to FDs at once
Show Buckets 1–2 cover the next years; avoid selling equity low; apply guardrails; no market predictions
check.why: Show Buckets 1–2 cover the next years; avoid selling equity low; apply guardrails; no market predictions.
